$comment: DocxSessionOps methods deliberately left out of the op descriptions (issue #982), each with the reason. They are the lifecycle, transaction, preview and delivery-evidence entry points: stateful or composite calls that are not one flat facade call, which docs/architecture/session_op_descriptions.md keeps hand-written. SessionOpDescriptionDriftTests.OPD000 fails when a public DocxSessionOps method is neither described nor listed here.

methods.OpenSession: Session lifecycle: takes package bytes and settings and mints the handle every other op addresses.
methods.Save: Session lifecycle: returns package bytes, each transport framing them its own way (base64, Uint8Array, file write).
methods.SaveWithAnchorIds: Session lifecycle: Save with anchor ids persisted, framed per transport like Save.
methods.CreateBlankDocx: Sessionless bytes factory, not an op on a session.
methods.BeginTransaction: Transactions: returns a .NET transaction object, never crosses a transport.
methods.BeginMutationTransaction: Transactions: stateful multi-call protocol around a batch.
methods.CompleteMutationTransaction: Transactions: stateful multi-call protocol around a batch.
methods.AbandonMutationTransaction: Transactions: stateful multi-call protocol around a batch.
methods.CheckPreconditions: Transactions: evaluates the shared mutation-precondition envelope, not an op of its own.
methods.ExecuteBatch: Composite: runs a list of other ops.
methods.ExecuteBatchTransactional: Composite: runs a list of other ops inside a transaction.
methods.PreviewBatch: Previews: runs a batch on a shadow session.
methods.CommitPreview: Previews: commits a shadow session's result to its live session.
methods.RetainPreview: Previews: retains a shadow session's package for a later guarded commit.
methods.BeginDeliveryEvidence: Delivery evidence: stateful multi-call protocol that records ops for a receipt.
methods.CompleteDeliveryEvidence: Delivery evidence: stateful multi-call protocol that records ops for a receipt.
methods.CompleteDeliveryEvidenceDirect: Delivery evidence: stateful multi-call protocol that records ops for a receipt.
methods.AbandonDeliveryEvidence: Delivery evidence: stateful multi-call protocol that records ops for a receipt.
methods.ExportDeliveryEvidence: Delivery evidence: exports the recorded evidence of the protocol above.
methods.GetDeliveryEvidenceStatus: Delivery evidence: reports the state of the protocol above.
methods.BuildDeliveryReceipt: Delivery evidence: composes a receipt from the recorded evidence and the package.
methods.GetVersion: Internal: the numeric version behind GetVersionJson, which is the op every transport calls (described in queries).
methods.UndoChecked: Not separately exposed: the undo op switches to it when a call carries a mutation-preconditions envelope (described as undo).
methods.RedoChecked: Not separately exposed: the redo op switches to it when a call carries a mutation-preconditions envelope (described as redo).
methods.GetTrackedChanges: Internal: only builds the response of MCP docxodus_track_changes set_mode; no transport exposes it.
methods.GetImageCapabilities: Sessionless: takes no session handle; it reports what the build can decode, not a property of a document.
methods.VerifyDeliverable: Composite: runs the deliverable-verification policy over a checkpoint of the whole package, with an optional request object.
